content.text: Digital creators in Bangladesh, you're no stranger to the challenges of getting paid. With Stripe and PayPal off-limits, you're left to navigate a world of workarounds and limitations. But what if you could break free from these constraints and take control of your commerce infrastructure? With sovereign commerce, you can own your store, your customers, and your payments. No more relying on third-party platforms that can suspend your account at any moment. It's time to build a financial foundation that's as secure as it is scalable. Let's explore the options and find the one that's right for you.
What Each Option Actually Offers

Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle are popular alternatives to Stripe and PayPal, but they come with their own set of limitations. They often charge higher fees, have stricter KYC requirements, and can be unpredictable in their support. In contrast, the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack offer a fully customizable, open-source solution that lets you own every aspect of your commerce infrastructure. With these stacks, you get to decide how you want to handle payments, customer data, and product delivery. You're not limited to a one-size-fits-all approach, and you can always scale up or down as your business needs change.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

When it comes to restricted countries, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle often have strict rules in place. They may block certain countries or require additional verification, which can limit your ability to sell to customers in those regions. In contrast, the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are designed to work around these restrictions. They use open-source tools and cryptocurrency-based payment processing, which allows you to reach customers in even the most restricted countries. This means you can tap into new markets and grow your business without being held back by geographical limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed and fees, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle often have high transaction fees and unpredictable processing times. In contrast, the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack use cryptocurrency-based payment processing, which offers faster transaction times and lower fees. With these stacks, you can process payments in real-time, and you'll only pay a flat fee of 0.5% on each transaction. This means you can keep more of your revenue and invest it back into your business.
You own every aspect of your commerce infrastructure, from payment processing to customer data.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When it comes to ownership, automation, and delivery, the Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack offer a level of control and customization that's unmatched by Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle. With these stacks, you get to decide how you want to handle customer data, product delivery, and order management. You can automate repetitive tasks and focus on high-leverage activities like marketing and content creation. This means you can grow your business faster and more efficiently, without being held back by manual processes and outdated technology.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

So, which architecture is right for you? If you're just starting out, the Sovereign Starter Stack is a great option. It offers a basic but robust commerce infrastructure that's easy to set up and customize. On the other hand, if you're looking for a more advanced solution with features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, the Edge Commerce Stack is the way to go.
